Torch-Spyre · Gemma 4 · View Operations Analysis

Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it — View Op Report

Only modules that contain at least one view/layout op. View op rows are highlighted. All other ops in those modules are shown for context.

328modules with view ops
2253view op instances
3843total ops in these modules
11distinct view op types
View ops covered: aten.view · aten._unsafe_view · aten.reshape · aten.permute · aten.transpose · aten.t · aten.squeeze · aten.unsqueeze · aten.flatten · aten.expand · aten.slice · aten.select · aten.narrow · aten.cat · aten.stack · aten.clone · aten.contiguous · aten.split · aten.chunk

Where they come from: Linear layers emit aten.t + aten.view + aten._unsafe_view (weight transpose + batch reshape). Gemma4TextAttention emits aten.view + aten.transpose (Q/K/V head split & reorder) plus aten.expand + aten.clone (GQA expansion) and aten.cat (RoPE concat & KV-cache append). Gemma4RMSNorm emits aten.unsqueeze. Gemma4TextExperts emits aten.view (flatten tokens for batched expert GEMM).
